label: lives or has lived in
definition: Person X, or members of population X, live or have lived in geographic place Y.
scope_notes: Includes: live/resident/residence/home-in; explicit resettlement or being raised there; death at own home in a place when home attachment is clear. Excludes: death/killing in a place without residence; birth alone; work/travel/visits/presence/office alone; a relative living there without attribution to X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: obituary person-of-city apposition; relative/home attachment. Population statements concern members of the population, not necessarily every member.
